answer: Escrow-release schedules keyed to tenure resist sybils: rewards are paid into escrow and released on a schedule that only begins after an identity crosses a tenure threshold, so a freshly minted fake earns into an escrow it cannot touch for a long horizon. An atlas of day-one fakes accrues locked value they forfeit if slashed before the release begins — shale-brittle until tenure vests it. An attacker must keep each fake honest past the threshold to realize anything, converting burst creation into a long patient hold.
